scope.intended_use: A funny, uplifting, non-functional comic octopus figurine for decorative display on a dry indoor adult desk or shelf.
scope.user_context: Adult owner or customer; static display and occasional low-force handling at room temperature.
out_of_scope: Functional organizer, holder or load-bearing role
Third-party character, artwork, logo, brand or scanned likeness
Outdoor, wet, food-contact, vehicle, electrical, medical or safety use
Commercial release before rights, physical, appearance and human approval gates pass

entities.name: Dry flat indoor desk or shelf
Adult user handling and viewing the figurine
Image generation and local geometry-only Step1X-3D toolchain

interfaces.name: Figurine to dry flat desk support

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the planned flat hidden underside
coordinate_frame.x_positive: character right when viewed from the front

datums.description: dry flat desk or shelf plane

allowed: free placement and lifting by an adult
constrained: rocking or tipping during static display

assembly.direction: place vertically downward onto the desk plane
assembly.sequence_notes: No fasteners, adhesive or purchased pad is planned.

dimensions.feature: flat support footprint and centre-of-mass margin

environment_and_variation.environment: dry flat indoor desk or shelf at room temperature

keepouts_and_access: Keep the underside free of unsupported texture and unstable point contacts.
Reserve a broad low-stress region for the later product mark.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The display context and control concept are known, but no geometry, mass, centre of gravity or physical stability result exists.

failure_modes.mode: The generated footprint is narrow, curved or uneven.
failure_modes.effect: The figurine rocks or tips and the display intent is not met.
failure_modes.mitigation: Create a controlled flat support plane and require the four-direction 10-degree tilt test.

acceptance_criteria: The printed figurine remains upright without sliding or rocking at 10 degrees in four cardinal directions on the recorded test surface.

interfaces.name: Adult hand to comic-octopus freeform surface

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the planned flat hidden underside
coordinate_frame.x_positive: character right when viewed from the front

datums.description: all user-reachable outer body and tentacle surfaces

allowed: ordinary lifting, turning, dusting and repositioning by an adult
constrained: pinching, sharp-point contact or loose detached fragments

assembly.sequence_notes: No ergonomic grip or load-carrying function is claimed.

dimensions.feature: minimum user-reachable tentacle tip or facial feature thickness

environment_and_variation.environment: ordinary adult handling in dry indoor conditions

keepouts_and_access: No needle-like tips, isolated thin fingers, whiskers or unsupported loose accessories.
No child-toy, skin-safety, allergen or biocompatibility claim.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The minimum-feature target follows the pinned process, but no generated surface or printed part exists for measurement or touch inspection.

failure_modes.mode: A generated tentacle tip or facial feature is too thin or sharp.
failure_modes.effect: The print feels unpleasant, looks damaged or breaks during ordinary handling.
failure_modes.mitigation: Thicken and radius all user-reachable features, then run mesh and physical edge checks.

acceptance_criteria: No user-reachable feature is thinner than 1.35 mm at released scale.
No edge feels sharp during a documented bare-hand wipe after normal support removal.

drivers: GEO 2/4: the appearance is an organic but non-fit-critical body whose unseen depth is synthesized from a single image.
PAR 1/4: one custom printed body needs a controlled flat underside and minimum-feature cleanup after generation.
REQ/MAT/VER 1/4: the small requirement set, pinned FFF baseline and basic mesh, stability and appearance checks remain straightforward.

blocking_unknowns: No concept image, generated geometry, mesh measurement, physical print, stability test or appearance review exists.
Single-image Step1X hidden geometry will be synthesized and cannot be treated as observed or dimensionally authoritative.
Seller identity, target markets/channels, source/tool terms, outgoing licence and commercial approvals remain UNKNOWN/BLOCK.

criticality.rationale: The scope is a static, non-functional adult desk decoration. Credible failure is aesthetic dissatisfaction, wasted print, rocking or low-energy tipping. Any sharp, loose or fragile feature is a failed acceptance item rather than an accepted product condition.
credible_failure_effects: The print looks unlike the approved cheerful comic character.
The figurine rocks or tips on the desk.
A thin feature breaks and the print is rejected.

decision.rationale: C0 complexity and K0 criticality support the generative Lane A route. Requirements revision 0.1.0 is explicitly approved, so work may proceed to the mandatory concept image. LOW_UNKNOWN reflects R2 and the absence of any image, geometry or physical evidence; it is not release confidence.

warnings.message: The planned body will be generated from one image. Rear depth, underside and internal volume are synthesized and require explicit mesh inspection and engineering cleanup.
Requirements revision 0.1.0 is approved, but no whole-product concept image has yet been generated or reviewed.
No concept, model, print, measurement, stability result or physical appearance review exists.
Seller, market, source/tool terms, outgoing licence, product classification and authorized release approvals remain open.

next_actions.action: Generate one whole-product concept sheet and record its prompt, provenance and SHA-256.
next_actions.exit_criterion: A versioned product-local concept image depicts the complete product and awaits human Gate 0B review.

next_actions.action: Only after concept approval, run the local geometry-only Step1X workflow and inspect the raw proposal.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The run record is hash-bound and the selected raw mesh has recorded component, topology, silhouette and hidden-geometry findings.

next_actions.action: Before any release, create a controlled flat base, validate topology/features/stability and close commercial gates.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The selected candidate passes deterministic and physical acceptance criteria plus authorized human release decisions.
